svg.aria-label: Reviewer Assignment: match every submission to the reviewers who know it best, never with a conflict of interest, within everyone's workload, and prove nothing better exists. Animation: a conflict of interest is ruled out, then 12 reviewer-paper pairs are drawn, each reviewer taking at most 3 papers, and a 'proven optimal' badge appears.
svg.title: Reviewer Assignment
svg.text: Who should review which paper? Match every submission to the
reviewers who know it best, never with a conflict of interest,
within everyone's workload, and prove nothing better exists.
